_comment: wave 21 (catalog type-reflection, batch 2): the now-public meos_catalog.h enum-argument reflection functions the Spark binding requested. Five MeosType->bool predicates and four enum->name accessors (const_char_out). Enum operand = an INT32 cast to the catalog enum (meostype_base/meosoper_base/tempsubtype_base/interptype_base); geo_typename takes a plain int.

operators.comment_one_liner: geo_basetype (bool) - whether a MEOS base type is a geo type.
basetype_byvalue (bool) - whether a MEOS base type is passed by value.
basetype_varlength (bool) - whether a MEOS base type is variable-length.
spatial_basetype (bool) - whether a MEOS base type is a spatial type.
type_span_bbox (bool) - whether a MEOS type has a span bounding box.
meosoper_name (const char *) - the name of a MEOS operator.
geo_typename (const char *) - the name of a geo type tag.
tempsubtype_name (const char *) - the name of a temporal subtype.
interptype_name (const char *) - the name of an interpolation type.
